Definition
[Reduced volume and strong collapse] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0133 1. ch19:eq-19.57,ch19:19.50\group Reduced Geometry

For backward flow, define \[ \widetilde V(\tau )=\int _M(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-\ell (q,\tau )}\, d\mu _{g(\tau )}. \] Strong $\kappa $-collapse at $(q_0,t_0)$ and scale $r$ means $|\Rm |\le r^{-2}$ in the associated parabolic cylinder and $\Vol B(q_0,r)/r^n<\kappa $.
